about_text: I explore the chaos of creativity through gaming, fixing broken engines, and immersing myself in 90s cyber-aesthetics. Life without play is just a system.

experience.title: Master Builder
experience.description: Currently constructing a 1/8th scale fully functional jet engine. Documenting the process through 3D renders.

experience.title: Retro Modder
experience.description: Restored and heavily modified classic arcade cabinets. Integrated modern hardware while preserving CRT scanlines.

experience.title: Digital Nomad
experience.description: Traveled across 14 countries while building open-source tools for the speedrunning community.

projects.title: CyberDeck Mk. IV
projects.description: Custom-built portable terminal using mechanical switches and a split ortholinear layout.

projects.description: A photography series exploring the night aesthetics of Tokyo and Seoul.
